summary: The profile has enough repeated evidence to tighten risk and decision-labeling rules, but not enough executed trade history to claim a trading edge. The clearest immediate issue is process risk: the only open position, AVAV, was initiated minutes before scheduled earnings without an explicit hold-through-print rule. Broader missed-mover ideas are useful backlog items, but they are still mostly one-session observations.

top_priority.title: Block Unplanned Late Earnings Entries
top_priority.why_now: AVAV created real overnight event exposure from a technically fair entry placed minutes before an after-close earnings call. This is a process-control failure with asymmetric downside and does not require more samples to justify a guardrail.
top_priority.expected_impact: Prevents future monitor cycles from converting normal technical entries into unmanaged binary-event bets.

priority_queue.title: Block Unplanned Late Earnings Entries
priority_queue.reason: The current portfolio has one AVAV position opened immediately before earnings; a cutoff or explicit hold-through flag is a low-complexity guardrail against repeat event-risk mistakes.

priority_queue.title: Separate Entry, Avoid, Thesis, and Data Confidence
priority_queue.reason: This has repeated support across QCOM, GM, HOOD, and MU and is already reflected in weekly observations and lessons. It should be implemented as a prompt/output-schema change, not mixed with scanner changes.

priority_queue.title: Invalidate Failed Buy Ranges Until Fresh Setup Forms
priority_queue.reason: Repeated evidence across QCOM, GM, and HOOD shows the rule prevented stale bullish recycling. It belongs in execution gating or monitor configuration.

priority_queue.title: Treat Missing VWAP as Unknown, Not Failed
priority_queue.reason: WDC is a meaningful miss, and data-quality notes support the diagnosis, but this has only one clear occurrence. Prepare a narrow data-quality flag and alternate confirmation path rather than broadly weakening VWAP discipline.

priority_queue.title: Expand Theme Mapping to Adjacent Liquid Winners
priority_queue.reason: ASTS, RKLB, SPCX, MRNA, and AMKR show screening gaps, but the sample is still a small set of missed movers. Track reason codes first so the scanner backlog is ranked by recurrence.

priority_queue.title: Add Afternoon Regime Escalation
priority_queue.reason: June 29 under-called the strength of QQQ/SPY, but the existing regime library already supports selective risk-on escalation. More sessions are needed before changing regime logic beyond enforcing the current criteria.

strong_signals: Action-specific confidence is repeatedly supported: high confidence often meant avoid/watch confidence, not buy confidence, across QCOM, GM, HOOD, and MU.
Failed buy ranges should not be recycled without a fresh setup; QCOM, GM, and HOOD all supported this rule with three recorded occurrences and no adverse trade outcome.
VWAP, opening-range, and peer confirmation prevented several low-quality entries during mixed or crowded tapes.
There is still almost no realized trade sample; snapshots show mostly cash until one AVAV entry on 2026-06-29.
weak_signals: The WDC missing-VWAP miss is important but currently one clear occurrence, so it supports a data-quality distinction rather than a wholesale relaxation of VWAP rules.
Theme expansion to ASTS/RKLB/SPCX/MRNA/AMKR is plausible, but the evidence is a small missed-opportunity set rather than a measured recurring scanner failure.
Afternoon risk-on escalation is based mainly on one strong QQQ/SPY rebound with small-cap lag.
Strategy effectiveness has only one recorded trade sample, AVAV, and its outcome is unresolved in the profile state.
recommended_changes_now: Add a hard block on new entries during the final 30 minutes before scheduled earnings unless an explicit hold-through-earnings flag is present.
Require the next monitor cycle to resolve AVAV first using post-earnings price action and the predeclared stop/hold criteria.
Prepare prompt/schema changes so confidence is labeled separately for entry, avoid, thesis, and data quality.
Prepare execution gating so a breached pre-entry stop reference forces invalidated or repair-watch status until a fresh setup forms.
changes_to_avoid_now: Do not broaden watchlists aggressively just because several adjacent winners were missed in one session.
Do not weaken VWAP confirmation globally; only distinguish unavailable data from failed confirmation.
Do not promote neutral-to-risk-on escalation into an automatic buy permission without symbol-level gates.
Do not judge strategy edge from the current PnL sample because there is only one unresolved executed position.
operator_note: Implement the earnings cutoff first and manage AVAV before optimizing opportunity capture. The next best upgrade is schema discipline around confidence and failed-setup state; scanner expansion should wait for tracked missed-mover reason codes.
